title: AK Region Product ISO Schema
description: Minimum required fields and terms for metadata written for USFWS Alaska Region data products. Enforces ISO 19115-1 core elements (language, topicCategory, extent, referenceSystemInfo, lineage) and DCAT required properties, to the extent possible in mdSchema (distributionFormat, constraints/license). Note: accessLevel, bureauCode, and programCode (DCAT-US/Project Open Data fields) were intentionally omitted — they have no native mdJSON element and no corresponding mdEditor UI component, so they cannot be captured through this tool. If Data.gov/POD submission is required, collect these fields downstream of mdEditor as part of the ISO-to-DCAT-US crosswalk rather than in the metadata record itself.

errorMessage.enum: Product status in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab must be one of: 'completed', 'onGoing', 'proposed', or 'accepted'

errorMessage.not: Resource type for products must not be 'product' or 'project' in the 'Resource Types' section under the 'Main' tab. Products should use a more specific type such as 'tabularDataset' or 'document'. For projects, use the custom profile for AK Region projects.

required.code: A dataset language code (ISO 639-2, e.g. 'eng') must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element.

errorMessage.minItems: At least one ISO topic category (e.g. 'biota', 'environment', 'oceans') must be selected in the 'Keywords' tab from an 'ISO 19115' Thesaurus. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element used for catalog theme/category mapping.

errorMessage.const: The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Steward listed with the role 'pointOfContact'.
The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Custodian, often the data manager, listed with the role 'custodian'.
The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Trustee, often a supervisor or program leadership, listed with the role 'owner'.
The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Producer/Originator, often the person collectiong or creating the data, listed with the role 'originator'.

errorMessage.role: Project data management personnel must be provided in the 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab. Roles that must be included are Data Trustee (owner), Data Steward (pointOfContact), Data Custodian (custodian), and Data Producer/Originator (originator).
errorMessage.party: At least one person must be assigned to each role in the 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab.

required.date: At least one date (e.g. acquisition, creation, lastUpdate, publication) must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.dateType: A type must be provided for dates in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

errorMessage.const: A responsible organization with the role of 'publisher' must be listed in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

required.identifier: Provide a unique identifier (e.g. Digital Object Identifier (DOI), ISBN, UUID) for the product in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.namespace: Provide the context (namespace) for the product identifier in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

errorMessage.minItems: A persistent identifier (DOI, UUID, etc.) must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab. DCAT requires a stable dct:identifier for each dataset.

required.title: A short, descriptive product title must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. Product titles should be uniquely identifiable.
required.date: At least one date (e.g. acquisition, creation, lastUpdate, publication) must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.responsibleParty: A responsible party with the role of 'publisher' must be listed in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.identifier: A persistent identifier must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

errorMessage.oneOf: A start date and/or an end date must be provided for this data product in the 'Time Period' section under the 'Main' tab.

required.keyword: At least one keyword must be provided from each thesaurus under the 'Keywords' tab.
required.thesaurus: At least one keyword thesaurus must be provided under the 'Keywords' tab.

title.const: Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords

errorMessage.const: At least one keyword under the 'Keywords' tab must be from the Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords thesaurus.

required.status: The current product status must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. Status must be one of: 'completed', 'onGoing', 'proposed', or 'accepted'
required.resourceType: Resource type must be provided in the 'Resource Types' section under the 'Main' tab. The resource type for products must not be 'product', but should instead use a more specific type (e.g. tabularDataset, geospatialDataset, report).
required.language: A dataset language must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element.
required.topicCategory: At least one ISO topic category must be selected in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element.
required.pointOfContact: Project and product specific personnel must be provided in the 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.abstract: An abstract for the product must be provided in the 'Description' section under the 'Main' tab. Abstracts should summarize the product's relation to the broader scientific endeavor.
required.timePeriod: A relevant time period for the product must be provided in the 'Time Period' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.keyword: Product keywords must be provided under the 'Keywords' tab. At least one keyword must be provided from the Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords thesaurus.

required.date: A creation date for the metadata must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.dateType: A date type must be provided for dates associated with the metadata in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.

errorMessage.const: At least one date with the type 'creation' must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
At least one metadata contact must have the role 'author' under the 'Metadata Contacts' section of the 'Metadata' tab.
At least one metadata contact must have the role 'pointOfContact' under the 'Metadata Contacts' section of the 'Metadata' tab.

required.role: A role must be provided in the 'Metadata Contacts' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.party: A contact must be provided in the 'Metadata Contacts' section under the 'Metadata' tab.

required.metadataStatus: The status of the metadata (e.g. onGoing, completed), must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.metadataDate: The creation date of the metadata must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.metadataContact: Contacts for metadata creation must be provided in the 'Metadata Contact' section under the 'Metadata' tab. Roles must include at least 'pointOfContact' and 'author'.

required.boundingBox: A geographic bounding box (west/east/north/south coordinates) must be provided in the 'Extent' tab. This satisfies the ISO 19115 conditional extent requirement and populates DCAT's dct:spatial property.

properties.geographic: At least one geographic extent (bounding box) must be provided in the 'Extent' tab for spatially-referenced products.

required.code: A coordinate reference system code (e.g. EPSG:4326) must be provided in the 'Extent' or 'Spatial Reference' section for spatially-referenced products.

errorMessage.minItems: At least one reference system (CRS) must be provided for spatially-referenced products.

required.statement: A lineage statement describing the history, sources, and processing of this product must be provided under the 'Lineage' tab. This is required by ISO 19115 whenever a full data quality report is not otherwise supplied.

required.type: A constraint type (e.g. 'useConstraints', 'legalConstraints', 'license') must be provided under the 'Constraints' tab.
required.value: A constraint value or statement (e.g. license name/URL, or 'no restrictions') should be provided under the 'Constraints' tab.

errorMessage.minItems: At least one constraint (license or use/access statement) must be provided under the 'Constraints' tab. DCAT and DCAT-US require an explicit license or access-rights statement (dct:license / dct:accessRights) for every published dataset.
errorMessage.contains: At least one constraint must specify a license, use constraint, or legal constraint under the 'Constraints' tab.

errorMessage.const: Role for distributor under the 'Distribution' tab must be 'distributor'.

required.role: Indicate 'distributor' as the role for the product distributor under the 'Distribution' tab.
required.party: Indicate the organization that will distribute the product as the contact under the 'Distribution' tab.

required.uri: A URI must be provided for an online option to access the resource under the 'Transfer Option' section of the 'Distributor' section under the 'Distribution' tab. The URI should link to either the direct download (URI that will automatically start a download) or the link to page where you can download the resource.

required.name: A distribution format (e.g. 'CSV', 'Shapefile', 'GeoTIFF') must be named under the 'Transfer Option' section of the 'Distribution' tab.

required.onlineOption: An online option for distribution must be provided in the 'Transfer Option' section of the 'Distributor' section under the 'Distribution' tab.
required.distributionFormat: A distribution format must be specified in the 'Transfer Option' section of the 'Distribution' tab. DCAT requires a format/mediaType for every distribution.

required.contact: Provide a contact for distribution under the 'Distribution' tab.
required.transferOption: A transfer option must be provided for distribution under the 'Distribution' tab.

required.distributor: Provide a distributor for the resource under the 'Distribution' tab.

required.associationType: Data products with associations must have an association type listed under the 'Associations' tab.
required.resourceCitation: Provide the citation information for the associated resource under the 'Associations' tab.

errorMessage.const: At least one association type must be parentProject under the 'Associations' tab.

required.resourceDistribution: Resource distribution must be described under the 'Distribution' tab.
required.constraints: At least one license/use/access constraint must be described under the 'Constraints' tab.
required.lineage: A lineage statement must be provided under the 'Lineage' tab.

required.dataDictionary: Data products with the type 'tabularDataset' must be associated with a data dictionary under the 'Dictionaries' tab.

errorMessage.if: If this data product is a tabular dataset, then it must be associated with a data dictionary under the 'Dictionaries' tab.

properties.metadata: Spatially-referenced data products must include a geographic extent and reference system. If this product genuinely has no spatial component, set its resource type to 'document' or 'nonGeographicDataset' instead.

errorMessage.allOf: This record failed one or more conditional ISO/DCAT compliance checks. See individual field messages above.
